policy.positive_margin: team expected or actual to win
policy.positive_advantage: model closer than market under the named lens
policy.positive_bias: performance or actual margin minus model margin; model underrated team
policy.performance_margin: equal average of SP+ adjusted margin and CFBD equivalent margin only when both lenses exist; otherwise unavailable while each lens remains separate
policy.performance_vs_model: performance_margin minus frozen standard_model_margin; primary signed diagnostic and ranking basis
policy.score_vs_model: actual_margin minus frozen standard_model_margin; secondary scoreboard diagnostic
policy.display_model_fit_alias: compatibility alias equal to performance_vs_model; not a separate metric
policy.benchmarks: score, SP+ adjusted performance margin, and CFBD equivalent margin remain separately visible; no partial combined value is fabricated
policy.accepted_value_policy: available accepted postgame lens values persist across temporary source omissions; an available source row may explicitly revise its own value
policy.sp_plus_adjusted_margin: direct source truth from the SP+ POSTGAME WIN EXPECTANCY table

cfbd_equivalent_margin.interpolation: linear between anchors with exact sign symmetry below 50%
cfbd_equivalent_margin.provenance: project reference conversion of CollegeFootballData /games postgame win probability; not an official CFBD-published point margin
cfbd_equivalent_margin.endpoint_policy: 0 maps to -65.0 and 1 maps to +65.0 under the approved reference tail

policy.deprecated_public_model_fit_conversion: pgwe_adjusted_margin_v1 is research-only and does not feed this contract
policy.rank_policy: signed descending performance_vs_model among teams with at least one complete two-lens performance game; all FBS teams remain present and no-sample teams are unranked
policy.fbs_universe_note: result closing_home_spread selects gradeable completed games; no-sample FBS teams remain explicit and unranked
